name: open-context
description: Personal Knowledge Graph - Browser Extension + Web App

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w extension" "npm run dev -w app" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w app && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w extension && npm run lint -w app && npm run lint -w server
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules extension/node_modules app/node_modules server/node_modules shared/node_modules
